newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat closes lower in light correction.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat closes lower in light correction.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled lower after a light-volume correction to the rally of the past three days, traders said.

Traders said wheat was under pressure early after the release of a disappointing export sales report. USDA said Thursday that net export sales of wheat during the week ended July 17 totaled 259,500 tonnes, below expectations for 400,000 to 500,000 tonnes.
But traders said they had seen moderate scale-down commercial buying, with Continental and Cargill each picking up at least 500,000 Sept bushels.
Traders said short-covering toward the close helped the market pare earlier losses.
Spring wheat settled 3/4 to 2-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with Sept down two cents at $3.89-3/4. Earlier, Sept hit an intraday low of $3.85.
Benson-Quinn was a featured seller, shedding around 800,000 Sept bushels. Linnco bought 1.5 million Sept and Atwood/Peavey bought one million Sept.
MGE estimated Thursday's volume at 15.65 million bushels, almost half of Wednesday's volume of 30.585 million bushels.
